name: NASA OPERA
description: Search and visualize NASA OPERA products (surface water, land disturbance, SAR backscatter) on the map: granule footprints from NASA CMR, rasters from titiler-cmr, with no Earthdata login.
author: Qiusheng Wu

commands.label: Refresh
commands.help: Read the search results on the map again.

commands.label: Search
commands.help: Search NASA CMR for granules of the chosen product over the map view (or the selected features) and the chosen months, and draw their footprints.
commands.params: {"product"?: CMR short name (OPERA_L3_DSWX-HLS_V1…), "bbox"?: [west, south, east, north] (default: the map view), "start"?: "YYYY-MM-DD", "end"?: "YYYY-MM-DD" (default: the panel's months, or the latest granules), "limit"?: 1..100}

commands.label:
Choose
Granule
commands.help: Select the chosen granule (or every granule of the chosen date) on the map and list its layers.

commands.label: Display
commands.help: Show the selected footprints' granules (or the chosen granule) as raster layers, through titiler-cmr.
commands.params: {"granule"?: granule UR | "date"?: "YYYY-MM-DD" (default: the selected footprints, else the panel's choice), "band"?: layer token (B01_WTR, VV, VEG-DIST-STATUS…), "rescale"?: "min,max", "colormap"?: titiler colormap name (viridis, terrain…), "waterOnly"?: bool, "opacity"?: 0..100}

commands.label:
Display
All
commands.help: Show every granule found (up to 25) as raster layers.

commands.label:
Zoom to
Results
commands.help: Zoom to the footprints of the last search.

commands.label: Clear
commands.help: Remove the footprints and every OPERA raster layer from the map.

panel.title: NASA OPERA
panel.help: Search NASA OPERA granules over the map view and show them as raster layers.

items.label: Results
items.text: Pick a product and a month, then Search.

items.label: DSWx: water classes only
items.help: Hide cloud, snow and ocean classes, leaving open and partial surface water.
